shortDescription: Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro said on Thursday the state had secured more than $4 billion in life sciences and private-sector investment commitments over the past week.Here are more details:

children: Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro said on Thursday the state had secured more than $4 billion in life sciences and private-sector investment commitments over the past week.
On Wednesday, Pennsylvania secured a $2.9 billion investment from Merck
to expand to its operations in Montgomery County by the end of 2030
Under this, Merck will invest $550 million to build a robotics and AI-enabled drug research and development facility for manufacturing and discovery of medicines

Last week, GSK said it would invest more than $800 million to expand its Upper Merion site into a new biopharmaceutical manufacturing and research hub, creating more than 300 jobs over the next five years

The state is also investing $371.5 million,, which will unlock an additional $200 million in private-sector investment and $266 million in federal support, to expand container capacity and auto capacity across the state's port facilities
The investments are expected to create more than 6,300 jobs for Pennsylvanians
